## Activity

Capture activity at Hill Counties Health Centre during December 2018 comprised 68 captures. This represents the recorded activity for the reporting month. The site continued to submit images for assessment, with all activity included in the results described below.

## Image quality

Image quality was reviewed as part of the routine assessment process. Of the 68 captures, 4 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.9. These images could not be used to support a grading outcome. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

Grading identified 8 referable results from the submitted captures. The median lag from capture to grading was 7. This provides the central measure of the time taken for images to proceed through the grading process. The results should be considered alongside the image-quality findings, including the 4 ungradable captures, when reviewing activity for Hill Counties Health Centre during December 2018.
